source: Chapter 681 Tomb
target: Capitulum 681: Sepulcrum

source: Chapter 681 Tomb
target: Capitulum 681: Sepulcrum

source: Robert rejoiced that the two patrol team members dealing with him had also been affected by Padre Cali’s scream.
target: Robert exsultavit quod duo membra turmae vigiliæ, quae cum eo operabant, etiam a clamore Padre Cali affecta erant.

source: He didn’t know what had happened to his lover, nor could he confirm it.
target: Nescivit quid amato suo acciderit, nec id confirmare potuit.

source: Enduring the swelling in his head and the pain in his eardrums, he rushed towards the altar.
target: Tolerans tumorem capitis et dolorem in auriculis, ad altare properavit.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: Rhea’s arrow struck the pile of clothes, but that wasn’t Robert’s destination—it was quite a distance away.
target: Sagitta Rheae in acervum vestimentorum incidit, sed non ibi Roberti destinatum erat – procul enim erat.

source: After landing on the ground, he rolled and hid behind the altar.
target: Postquam in terram cecidit, volutus est et post altare se abscondit.

source: Rhea drew the bowstring again, but she didn’t release the arrow immediately.
target: Rhea iterum chordam arcus extraxit, sed sagittam non statim emiit.

source: Robert’s body was completely blocked by the altar, making it impossible for her to aim.
target: Corpus Roberti ab altare omnino obtruncatum erat, ita ut Rhea destinare non posset.

source: As a devout believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun, it was also impossible for her to use the hunting bow’s unique abilities together with Raging Blow to directly shatter the altar.
target: Quia devota fide Solis Aeterni Flammarum erat, illi etiam impossibile erat uti singularibus facultatibus arcus venandi una cum Impetu Furioso ad altare directe confringendum.

source: Witnessing this, Camus, knowing his revolver’s power was insufficient, leaped over the shattered stained‐glass window and sprinted towards the altar.
target: Hoc videns, Camus, sciens vim sclopeti sui esse insufficientem, fenestram vitream fractam transiluit et ad altare cucurrit.

source: After a brief moment of hesitation, Rhea raised her hunting bow and shot an arrow wrapped in lightning into the air.
target: Post brevem momentum dubitationis, Rhea arcum venandi sustulit et sagittam, fulmine involutam, in aerem emisit.

source: The arrow flew high into the air before swiftly descending, bypassing the altar’s obstruction and landing behind it.
target: Sagitta in altum aeris volavit, deinde celeriter descendens, obstructionem altaris praeteriens, post altare consedit.

source: Since she hadn’t been able to aim properly, the arrow grazed Robert’s body and struck a crevice between two stone slabs.
target: Quia recte destinare non potuit, sagitta corpus Roberti leviter attigit et in fissuram inter duas lapideas laminas incidit.

source: A sizzling electric current dissipated, creeping over Robert’s body and temporarily paralyzing him.
target: Currens electricus sibilans evanuit, super corpus Roberti serpens, eum ad tempus immobilis reddens.

source: After breaking free, Robert abandoned the idea of retrieving his spirit channeling ingredients.
target: Postquam se liberavit, Robert propositum recuperandi ingredientia ad spiritum evocandum reliquit.

source: He had no intention of saving his lover, Padre Cali.
target: Nullum propositum habebat amatum suum servandi, Padre Cali.

source: He planned to bite the tip of his tongue again and complete the spirit channeling.
target: Constituit iterum apicem linguae suae mordere atque spiritus evocandi perficere.

source: With the special ability of the natural spirit, he could escape back to his plantation, where he still had plenty of spirituality‐rich ingredients for backup.
target: Cum singulari facultate spiritus naturae, ad praedia sua redire poterat, ubi adhuc copia ingredientorum spiritualium ad subsidium habebat.

source: At that moment, from the corner of his eye, he caught sight of Camus’s light-colored pants and leather shoes with holes.
target: Illo tempore, ex anguli oculi, conspexit bracas Camus coloris lucidi et calceos coriaceos cum foramina.

source: He felt a whip formed by electric currents appear in his mind.
target: Sentivit flagellum, e currentibus electricis constitutum, in mente sua apparare.

source: The whip struck his soul,
target: Flagellum animam eius percussit,

source: and Robert, crouched behind the altar, felt his knees buckle, and he collapsed, trembling as extreme numbness and pain surged through him simultaneously.
target: et Robert, post altare se abscondens, sensit genua labefacta esse et corruit, tremens dum maxima insensibilitas atque dolor simul eum pervadere videbantur.

source: Whip of Pain!
target: Flagellum Doloris!

source: Interrogator’s Whip of Pain!
target: Flagellum Doloris Inquisitoris!

source: Camus rushed to Robert’s side, leaned down, and delivered a left hook—one that more or less bore a personal grudge.
target: Camus ad Roberti partem properavit, se inclinavit, et ictum sinistrum dedit – ictum, qui paene rancorem personale gerebat.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Camus, skilled in interrogation techniques, inflicted pain on Robert without going overboard.
target: Camus, artibus interrogationis peritus, Roberto dolorem intulit, sed non nimis excessit.

source: Robert fainted, yet suffered no substantial harm.
target: Robertus evanuit, sed nullum laesum grave attulit.

source: After restraining Robert, Camus glanced at the naked man and selected nearby clothes to cover his private parts.
target: Post Robertum cohibitum, Camus hominem nudum conspexit et vestimenta proxima ad membra intima tegenda elegit.

source: He then picked up Robert and returned to where Lumian and the others were.
target: Deinde Robertum sublevavit et rediit ad locum, ubi Lumian et ceteri erant.

source: At that moment, Lugano had already retrieved the bullet that had struck Amandina’s shoulder, allowing the wound to contract and heal.
target: Illo tempore, Lugano iam recuperaverat globulum, qui humeri Amandinae percussus erat, sinens vulnus contrahi et sanari.

source: Padre Cali was dreaming of the interior of Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: Padre Cali somniabat de intimo Sanctae Sien Cathedrali.

source: Dressed in a white robe with golden threads, he knelt before the altar, muttering with a pained expression, as if repenting.
target: Indutus veste alba cum filiis aureis, ante altare genu flectum, submurmurabat vultu dolenti, quasi paenitentiam ageret.

source: Amandina, clad in a black hunting suit, approached Padre Cali down the aisle between the pews.
target: Amandina, veste venatoria nigra induta, per ambulacrum inter sedilia ad Padre Cali accessit.

source: Remembering Louis Berry’s instructions, she asked, “What’s the origin of this special dream?”
target: Meminens praecepta Ludovici Berry, interrogavit: “Quid est originis huius somnii peculiarii?”

source: Padre Cali looked up, his face contorted as he replied, “That… that strange tomb.”
target: Padre Cali aspexit, vultu contorto, et respondit: “Illud… illud sepulcrum insolitum.”

source: “Tomb?” Amandina suspected the Dream Festival she had just attended was a sham.
target: “Sepulcrum?” Amandina suspicabatur Festum Somniorum, quod nuper participaverat, simulacrum esse.

source: What tomb?
target: Quid sepulcrum?

source: Suddenly, a flash of inspiration flickered.
target: Subito scintilla inspirationis micavit.

source: “That colossal, black boulder?”
target: “Illud ingens, nigrum lapidem?”

source: It’s actually a tomb?
target: Revera sepulcrum est?

source: Padre Cali nodded.
target: Padre Cali annuit.

source: “Yes.”
target: “Sic.”

source: It’s really a tomb… Intrigued, Amandina asked proactively, “Whose tomb is that? Why is it so special?”
target: Revera sepulcrum est… Intrigata, Amandina prompte rogavit: “Cuius sepulcrum est hoc? Cur tam speciale est?”

source: Padre Cali remained kneeling, shaking his head.
target: Padre Cali genu flectens remansit, caput movens.

source: “I don’t know. Even the gravekeepers don’t know. They only know their mission is to guard that strange ancient tomb.”
target: “Nescio. Ne custodes quidem sepulchri sciunt. Tantum noverunt officium suum esse, ut illud sepulcrum antiquum et mirum custodire possint.”

source: “Gravekeepers? Who are they?” The more Amandina asked, the more she felt she didn’t know about the Dream Festival.
target: “Custodes sepulchri? Qui sunt illi?” Quo plura Amandina interrogabat, eo magis se de Festo Somniorum nescire sentiebat.

source: Padre Cali looked up at Amandina and said, “The elders of the forest tribe.”
target: Padre Cali ad Amandinam aspexit et dixit: “Seniores gentis silvestris.”

source: “I see…” Amandina’s mind raced with questions.
target: “Intellego…” Mentem Amandinae multitudine quaestionum repleta erant.

source: She picked one and asked, “Did you take Robert to Twanaku’s house to sleep and allow him to maintain his lucidity? Then, you took him to the ancient tomb where he obtained superpowers?”
target: Unam ex illis elegerat et rogavit: “Num Robertum ad domum Twanaku duxisti ad dormiendum ut luciditatem retineret? Tum eum ad sepulcrum antiquum duxisti, ubi vires supernaturales adeptus est?”

source: “Yes.” Padre Cali lowered his head, facing the altar, his voice laced with pain. “I’m sinful.”
target: “Ita.” Padre Cali caput inclinavit, ad altare versus, voce dolore tincta: “Peccator sum.”

source: Just as I thought… Amandina inquired further, “How did you know you could obtain superpowers there? And how did you maintain lucidity? You’ve only been in Tizamo for about five years, and I grew up here.”
target: Sicut putavi… Amandina pergere rogavit: “Quomodo novisti te ibi vires supernaturales adipisci posse? Et quomodo luciditatem retinuisti? Quinque tantum annos in Tizamo fuisti, et ego hic crevi?”

source: Blood vessels bulged from Padre Cali’s neck.
target: Vasa sanguinea ex collo Padre Cali eminuerunt.

source: “Twanaku, Twanaku, bewitched me.”
target: “Twanaku, Twanaku, me incantavit.”

source: “He used his body to tempt you?” Amandina suddenly felt a surge of excitement.
target: “Corpus suum ad te alliciendum usus est?” Amandina subito alacritate affecta est.

source: Padre Cali was taken aback.
target: Padre Cali obstupefactus est.

source: “He saw through my desire for status and recognition and gradually demonstrated his abilities. He also told me there was a way for me to quickly and easily obtain strength. And with great strength, I could do more for the Church and receive more rewards and recognition… That demon!”
target: “Percepit cupiditatem meam pro statū et honōre, et gradatim virtutes suas demonstravit. Etiam mihi dixerat viam esse ut celeriter et facile robur adipisci possem. Et cum magno robore, plura pro Ecclesia efficere et maiores mercedes atque honores accipere possem… Ille daemon!”

source: Amandina asked in disappointment, “You were bewitched just like that?”
target: Amandina, cum contritione, rogavit: “Sic modo incantatus es?”

source: Padre Cali nodded slowly.
target: Padre Cali lente annuit.

source: “That’s right. Twanaku needed someone to help him monitor the changes in the dream and host the Dream Festival after he left Tizamo. First, he got me to sleep at his house. Then, during the Dream Festival, he took me to that strange ancient tomb.”
target: “Sic est. Twanaku aliquem requirebat ut eum mutationes somnī monitoraret et Festum Somniorum moderaret, postquam Tizamo reliquerit. Primo, me in domo sua ad dormiendum concitavit. Deinde, durante Festo Somniorum, me ad illum sepulcrum antiquum et insolitum duxit.”

source: “Did you also obtain superpowers by touching that tomb?” Amandina asked casually.
target: “Num et, illum sepulcrum tangendo, super vires adeptus es?” Amandina leve rogavit.

source: Padre Cali shook his head again.
target: Padre Cali iterum caput movit.

source: “No, Twanaku opened a crack in the tomb and let me reach in…”
target: “Non, Twanaku in sepulcro fissuram aperuit et me intrudere concessit…”

source: “What did you touch?” Amandina couldn’t help but urge upon seeing Padre Cali’s pause.
target: “Quid tetigisti?” Amandina, videns moram Padre Cali, rogare non potuit nonque quaesivit.

source: “I touched a hand—a cold hand without temperature. Then, I fainted. When I woke up, I had superpowers. I did it three more times during the subsequent Dream Festivals, eventually becoming a Wraith.” Padre Cali recalled the situation, his face filled with uncontrollable fear—both of the cold hand and the ease with which he had obtained superpowers.
target: “Manum tetigi—manum frigidam sine calore. Deinde evanui. Cum experrectus sum, super vires adeptus eram. Hoc ter aliae vicibus in Festis Somniorum subsequenter feci, atque tandem factus sum Wraith. ”

source: “The hand of the corpse in the tomb?” Amandina quickly reviewed what Padre Cali had said and thought of a problem. “Didn’t you say there were gravekeepers? Why weren’t we stopped when Robert and I went?”
target: “Manus cadaveris in sepulcro?” Amandina celeriter recensebat verba Padre Cali et quaestionem effinxit: “Nonne dixisti custodes sepulchri esse? Cur nos non prohibiti sumus, cum Robertus et ego accessimus?”

source: Padre Cali’s voice deepened.
target: Vox Padre Cali profundior facta est.

source: “People who have lived in Tizamo for a long time often have a projection formed by suppressed emotions and desires in this special dream.”
target: Qui diu in Tizamo vixerunt, saepe proiectionem ex repressis emotis et cupiditatibus in hoc somnio peculiario habent.

source: “They usually hide in the chaotic area brought by the tomb, at the edge of the dream.”
target: Saepe latent in regione confusa, quam sepulcrum afferebat, in margine somnii.

source: “They watch over the ancient tomb with the gravekeepers to protect it from others.”
target: Illi, una cum custodes sepulchri, sepulcrum antiquum observant ad id a ceteris tuendum.

source: “When the Dream Festival begins, these projections will return to their true forms, forming complete Dream Festival participants who can no longer suppress their emotions and desires.”
target: Cum Festum Somniorum incipiet, hae proiectiones ad formas veras redeunt, formantes integros participes Festi Somniorum qui iam passiones et cupiditates suas reprimere non possunt.

source: “As for the gravekeepers, it’s unknown where they go.”
target: Quam ad custodes sepulchri attinet, ignotum est quo se conferant.

source: Strange… Amandina was puzzled by the gravekeepers’ whereabouts.
target: Mirum… Amandina de loco custodum sepulchri perplexa erat.

source: She was a little worried.
target: Paulum anxia erat.

source: After a moment of contemplation, she asked with concern, “Do I have a projection of emotions and desires in this dream?”
target: Post momentum cogitationis, sollicitata quaesivit: “Habebo-ne ego proiectionem passionum et cupiditatum in hoc somnio?”

source: Padre Cali shook his head.
target: Padre Cali iterum caput movit.

source: “No. You don’t spend enough time in Tizamo every year. Even for those who originally formed a dream projection, once they leave this place long enough and stop suppressing themselves, the corresponding projection will gradually fade until it disappears.”
target: “Minime. Non satis temporis in Tizamo singulis annis paras. Etiam, qui initio proiectionem somnii condiderunt, cum hoc locum diu relinquunt et se non amplius reprimunt, proiectiones eorum paulatim evanescunt, donec omnino evanuerint.”

source: “Those who can remain lucid in this dream will have their corresponding projections gradually dissipate over time. Details.”
target: Qui in hoc somnio lucidi manere possunt, proiectiones eorum paulatim dissolvuntur. Minutiae.

source: “However, this lucidity isn’t absolute.”
target: Tamen haec luciditas non est absoluta.

source: “After the Dream Festival begins, everyone will have a tendency to flaunt their emotions and desires—including those who maintain their lucidity.”
target: Post Festum Somniorum initium, omnes ad ostentationem passionum et cupiditatum inclinabuntur, etiam qui lucidi manent.

source: “However, they won’t completely lose control like those who have fused with their dream self.”
target: Attamen non omnino moderabuntur, quales sunt qui cum ipsa sua figura somniorum coniuncti sunt.

source: “They can continue restraining themselves like normal, their desires revealed in some details.”
target: Possunt se perseverare in moderandis ut consuetum est, cum cupiditates eorum in aliquibus minutis patefactae sint.

source: Amandina recalled her performance during the two Dream Festivals and revealed a look of enlightenment.
target: Amandina memoriam revocat de sua participatione in duobus Festis Somniorum et vultum illuminationis ostendit.

source: Initially, she believed that because this place was a dream, as long as no one died, it was equivalent to a game.
target: Initio credebat, quia hic locus somnium esset, dummodo nemo interiret, aequivalere ludo.

source: That was why she appeared more self-centered and unrestrained than in reality.
target: Idcirco videbatur magis sui ipsius centricus et laxior quam in veritate.

source: She didn’t expect this to come from the effect of the Dream Festival.
target: Non exspectabat hoc ex effectu Festi Somniorum provenire.

source: Thankfully, I’ve always had self-control… Amandina had ticked off most of the questions that Louis Berry wanted clarified, leaving only those that the Padre Cali himself wasn’t aware of.
target: Gratias Deo, semper me temperare potui… Amandina pleraque quaestiones, quas Ludovicus Berry explicationem cupiebat, enumeraverat, relinquens solum eas, de quibus ipse Padre Cali ignorabat.

source: Thus, she changed the subject.
target: Itaque rem mutavit.

source: “You’ve already become a Wraith, yet you still dare to preach and host Mass…
target: “Iam factus es Wraith, sed adhuc audes praedicare et Missam exsequi…

source: “Aren’t you concerned that God might notice you and unleash His wrath upon you, purifying you into ashes?”
target: “Nonne sollicitus es, ne Deus te detegat et iram suam super te effundat, te in cineres purgans?”

source: Being in the Southern Continent, Amandina knew the power of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church better than many gentlemen and ladies in Trier.
target: In Continente Meridionali versata, Amandina potentiam Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammarum melius noverat quam multi viri et feminae Trevirenses.

source: She had no doubts about the existence of God.
target: De existentia Dei nullas dubitationes habebat.

source: Moreover, over the past year, she had been diligently obtaining mysticism knowledge from Robert and the various sources she could come into contact with.
target: Praeterea, per annum praeteritum, diligenter mysticam scientiam ab Roberto et variis fontibus quibus contingere poterat, adeptata est.

source: She knew that the Rose School of Thought, the key characters of various terrifying rumors, was renowned for its numerous Wraiths, and Wraiths were most afraid of sunlight that came with purification.
target: Sciebat Schola Rosi Cogitationis, quorum characterēs in variīs rumoribus terribilium noti erant propter multitudinem Wraith, et Wraith maxime solem, qui cum purificatione venit, timere.

source: Padre Cali sighed and said, “I had such concerns, but Twanaku told me he had a way to help me hide a Wraith’s power. Unless God watches this place personally, I won’t be discovered.”
target: Padre Cali suspiravit et dixit: “Talis sollicitudinem habebam, sed Twanaku mihi dixerat viam esse ut potentiam Wraith absconderem. Nisi Deus hunc locum personaliter vigilaverit, non detegar.”

source: “What is it?” Amandina asked curiously.
target: “Quid est hoc?” Amandina curiosa rogavit.

source: Padre Cali replied truthfully, “After touching the corpse in the tomb and obtaining superpowers, don’t rush to leave. Touch the tomb itself again, the black boulder.”
target: Padre Cali fideliter respondit: “Postquam cadaver in sepulcro tetigi et vires supernaturales adeptus sum, noli festinare abire. Iterum tangas ipsum sepulcrum, lapidem nigrum.”

source: “This concealed all my superpowers. The effect will last for more than a year.”
target: “Hoc omnes super vires meas abscondit. Effectus plus quam annum durabit.”

source: That’s possible? What would happen if I touched the black boulder and then touched the corpse’s hand?
target: Idne fieri potest? Quid accideret, si lapidem nigrum tetigerim et deinde manum cadaveris attigerim?

source: Amandina pondered for a moment and asked a question of personal concern, “How did you entice Robert? Why did he become your lover?”
target: Amandina paulisper cogitavit et quaestionem personalem rogavit: “Quomodo Robertum allicuisti? Cur factus est amator tuus?”

source: Amandina sized him up but couldn’t find anything about Padre Cali that attracted Robert, other than his strength.
target: Amandina eum examinavit, sed nihil invenit de Padre Cali quod Robertum alliceret, praeter eius potentiam.

source: Could love truly be blind?
target: Num amor vere caecus esse possit?

source: Padre Cali fell silent for a moment before saying, “I ignited his desires, dismantling his self-control.”
target: Padre Cali paulisper tacuit antequam dixit: “Vota eius excitavi, continentiam eius dissolvens.”

source: “You’ve never displayed such abilities…” Amandina hadn’t noticed Padre Cali arousing any desires in the battle before.
target: “Numquam talem potentiam ostendisti…” Amandina ante intervallum non animadvertit quod Padre Cali desideria excitaret in proelio.

source: Padre Cali’s voice was once again tinged with pain.
target: Vox Padre Cali rursus dolore tincta erat.

source: “I’m sinful. I’m praying to the Demon Twanaku mentioned…”
target: “Peccator sum. Daemonem, quem Twanaku nominavit, precor…”

source: Before Padre Cali could finish, the entire dream suddenly trembled and collapsed inch by inch.
target: Priusquam Padre Cali finire posset, totum somnium repente tremuit et passu per passum corruit.
